rationale: Anchor: the statistical-model consensus from compare_forecast_models (h1 1609, h2 1886, h3 2326), with the hub empty for this off-season week (last submissions May), so no ensemble to lean on. I moved off the consensus toward the higher end (h1 1750, h2 2000, h3 2350) because the recent trajectory is a clear early-season takeoff: admissions 692→872→895→1227→1503 over the last five weeks (+22% wk/wk) and ILI climbing 0.87%→1.51%, matching the 2024-25 pattern where a September rise preceded a steep October-November climb. The last observed point (1503) is provisional and likely to revise upward, so I treat it as a floor. I kept h0 near the observed 1503 (median 1550) since it is already partly observed. Uncertainty widens with horizon and is right-skewed (lognormal): h3 spans ~825-6693 to cover both the gbt high (3505) and the seasonal/persistence low, reflecting the 2x spread among methods at h3 and the risk that an early start either accelerates into a strong season or stalls.
